headline: Kai, the ten-year topped 5.25 percent — a 19-year high — after Trump rejected Iran's offer to reopen Hormuz, and an October hike is now the market's base case.
subline: Futures are steady after Monday's slide, gold cracked to a seven-week low, and OpenAI shelved the model that failed its own safety bar.
asof: Pre-market · as of 6:40 AM ET · index values are futures · every figure links to its source below

items.title: Ten-year tops 5.25 percent, a 19-year high
items.sentence: The 10-year broke above 5.25 percent overnight and the 30-year reached 5.58 percent, its highest since 2004, per Saxo's morning note.

items.title: Markets lean toward an October hike
items.sentence: Odds of a hike at October's meeting sit near 70 percent after Vice Chair Barr said more tightening is likely, with this week's PCE and jobs data the deciders, per Stocktwits and CNBC.

items.title: Futures hold flat into a data morning
items.sentence: S&P futures sit near 7,745 after Monday's 0.77 percent slide, with August JOLTS, September consumer confidence, and Fed speakers Goolsbee and Williams all due this morning, per Yahoo Finance.

items.title: Gold cracks as hike bets harden
items.sentence: Gold slid to a seven-week low near $4,111 and silver broke below $62 as the oil spike lifted Fed rate-hike bets, per USAGOLD and Saxo.

items.title: Bitcoin steadies at $84,000
items.sentence: Bitcoin trades near $84,000 this morning, up 5.2 percent over the past month but still about a third below its October 2025 record of $126,198, per Yahoo Finance.

items.title: Trump rejects Iran's seven-day Hormuz plan
items.sentence: Trump turned down Tehran's offer to reopen the strait within seven days, pressing for nuclear concessions instead while saying he expects more talks this week, per TheStreet and Benzinga.

items.title: Hormuz oil flows rise despite threats
items.sentence: Iran International reports tanker traffic through the strait has crept higher even as Tehran keeps warning shipping away.

items.title: Midterms five weeks out, voters sour
items.sentence: Five weeks from the November vote, NPR's new poll finds Trump top of mind for midterm voters — and most of them unhappy about it.

items.title: Boeing hits 2026 low on MAX delay
items.sentence: The FAA delayed 737 MAX 10 certification and the stock fell 6.2 percent to a 2026 low, per TheStreet.

items.title: OpenAI shelves GPT-6.1 Astra on safety
items.sentence: A day after pausing frontier training, OpenAI canceled the planned release of GPT-6.1 Astra as safety concerns escalated, per CNBC.

items.title: OpenAI, Anthropic leaders urge AI oversight
items.sentence: Executives at both labs called for outside oversight of self-improving AI systems — an unusual joint ask in a week of safety retreats, per Bloomberg.

items.title: SoftBank sells $11 billion of junk for OpenAI
items.sentence: SoftBank launched an $11 billion junk-bond sale to fund its OpenAI bet, borrowing with Treasury yields at cycle highs, per Yahoo Finance and Bloomberg.

items.title: OpenAI's bid sparked the Hugging Face war
items.sentence: CNBC reports an early OpenAI investment offer set off the bidding that ended with Nvidia's $13 billion purchase of Hugging Face.

items.title: MongoDB drops 20 percent on CEO exit
items.sentence: Shares fell nearly 20 percent Monday after chief executive Desai left for Meta, per Yahoo Finance and TheStreet.
